answer: Let each identity bond C into sable staking collateral with non-refundable attestation fee f and zero-knowledge verifiable delay tau; for q clones, locked capital is qC plus forgone yield rqC while slashing lambda qC penalizes equivocation. The marginal adversary cost is Δ(q)=C+f+rC(1+rho)^{q-1}+lambda C q, strictly convex for rho>0 because f is sunk. Even when a garden of sybils harvests plume signals, expected utility EU=b-q[f+C(1+r+lambda)] stays negative once q exceeds b/[f+C(1+r+lambda)], so honest attestation is a strict Nash equilibrium.
